full_judgment:
10. The learned Advocate has relied upon the decision in the case of Mst Sughre Begum vs Miah Mohammad Din reported in PLD 1950 WP (Lahore) 441 in support of his contention. 

 22. Syed Ameer Ali cited the case of Mst Sughre Begum vs Muhammad reported in PLD 1950 WP (Lahore) 441 wherein their Lordships did not decide like this that the daughter will get maintenance till her marriage, rather their Lordships held therein that the female child will get maintenance upto the age of 21 years which has no footing. Because in the personal law of the Mohammedan, there is no such provision. There is no denying of the fact that a Mohammedan is guided by the tenets of Muslim Personal Law. 

 30. Mr Arun Kumar Bhattacharaya, the learned Advocate for the opposite party, submits that secular law, that is, section 488 of Code of Criminal Procedure is applicable to Mohammedans and that decision taken by in PLD 1950 WP Lahore 441 in connection with section 488 of the Code of Criminal Procedure is also applicable to Mohammedans.
